body.x: With LG Chem, LG Display, LG Innotek, and other member companies of the LG Group in on the project since the development stage, the Optimus G is the smartphone that represents the next phase of LG Electronics’ long-term strategy, and it’s the talk of the town. The phone design combines True HD IPS+, which was designed by LG Display, and GS Touch Hybrid, a touch technology completely unifying the cover glass that is the fruit of a joint project by LG Display and LG Innotek. With LG Chem’s 2,1000mAh high-capacity battery and LG Innotek's 13 megapixel camera module added to the mix, the smartphone represents the best work of the various companies that constitute the LG Group.

LG has also maintained its unique differentiated design. Using the "glass case complete unification touch" construction method, the company has reduced the bezel and width to 3mm and 8mm, respectively. This allowed them to bring to life a slim design and comfortable grip at a compact size that fits snugly in the palm of your hand. In addition, they synced the color of the screen when it is off with the black color of the phone body in an effort to make it look like the screen has no edges. They even applied the polished crystal reflection design method to the back of the phone.

In terms of convenience of use, LG offers a revolutionary user experience that will improve your quality of life. Live Zooming allows users to zoom in or zoom out on a portion of a video that is being played to make the movie appear larger or smaller. With Dual Screen Dual Play, not only can users enjoy Mirroring (having the smartphone screen appear on the TV), but they can also display different things on the TV and smart phone screens at the same time. This allows you, for example, to put a presentation slide on the TV while viewing the notes for that slide on your smart phone. There has also been an update for QMemo, which received rave reviews after it premiered on the Optimus Vu:. The upgrade allows you to add memos and even the relevant URL when sharing helpful articles or webpages online.

The phone is equipped with a 13 megapixel camera, which is the highest resolution available among smartphones released in Korea, and it offers oustanding picture quality even in places with little light. The camera offers a number of easily enjoyed camera functions including Time Machine Camera, which snags five shots starting one second before the shutter clicks, Sound Camera, which takes a picture only when someone makes a sound, and Smart Shutter, which can take pictures of moving objects without a blur.

But even beyond these functions, this is the first phone to feature True HD IPS+, which offers improvements over True HD IPS in the areas of brightness and power consumption, and Snapdragon S4 Pro (APQ8064), a LTE-based next generation quadcore processor newly released by Qualcomm. As a quadcore featuring the Snapdragon S4 Pro 1.5Ghz CPU, performance is as much as 40% higher than your standard quadcore. And with graphic processing speed more than three times faster than before, video, web browsing, games, GPS, and other aspects of the mobile graphic environment are better than ever.
